title: FrameX
tagline: Raise, manage, and fund absolutely anything from a Frame - onchain SPVs built for Syndicates, Venture DAOs and asset managers.
description: FrameX combines onchain SPV infrastructure of StationX Protocol and Farcaster Frames. FrameX is built for syndicates, venture DAOs, and asset managers wherein they can just spin out an onchain SPV, a station, on StationX to raise capital towards any goal (invest in startups, add DeFi LP, collect NFTs, RWAs etc.) by issuing LP tokens to contributors. Our project spins out a personalised Frame link for a particular station, allowing you to collect rule-based contributions from from a Frame.
how_its_made:
FrameX uses the following tech at its core: 
1. StationX - to spin out onchain SPVs. StationX is an infra that gives out LP tokens (ERC20s/NFTs) to contributors of a station. All the funds go into a safe, that is wrapped by the station and owned by the admin/manager. 
2. Base L2 - SPVs and Frames are deployed on top of Base L2. 
3. Pinata - used for Frame Analytics that every owner can see by adding the API Key on the Pinata dashboard. 
4. Airstack - used for wallet gating, token gating, channel gating etc. of FC users
5. Graph - to query real-time station data
